dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, isn't this a Fatui tent? That shouldn't be here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, but there are always those two Fatui around here, chatting about stuff...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: You've noticed them too? I've been watching them for a long time. Not that I've overheard anything useful...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Guess it's just my luck, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Well, actually, they seem to get information a bit slower than the Knights of Favonius... So, they usually end up discussing stuff that hasn't been secret in a long time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Have you guys ever wondered why they don't just... go home? Their mission's gotta be over at this point, right?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Maybe their names got skipped over on the mission roster, so they never got new orders? That's happened to me before.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: I suppose, but your experiences tend to be... quite unique.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: It's possible the Fatui stationed them here long-term to keep an eye on things. Or, maybe they volunteered for this position because they don't want to go back.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Either way, we should have Nicole take this tent down. It's making Paimon think we're gonna have to fight someone.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: True, and it's not like there's a treasure chest here either.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Haha, I guess you're right. We don't want people getting their hopes up.
